ocr.markdown:
9" pie plate
Tex Mex Dip
Spread can of beandip in bottom.

1 pkg taco seasoning
Gr. onions, chopped
Blk olives, chopped
Chopped tomatoes
Shredded cheddar cheese
Chill + serve w taco chips
